decisions.summary: Fixed quiz loading extra questions: removed flawed guard condition, fixed setQuizConfig/setQuizLimit/restartQuiz/resetQuiz not to set totalQuestions=maxQuestions
Calendar and quiz history now always syncs from server on every load, not just on fresh install (empty DB)

Fixed two bugs: 1) time_spent_seconds was hardcoded to 0 in server quiz attempt recording - now passes actual time from QuizAttempt; 2) quiz history was duplicating on every screen load - now clears local DB before syncing from server
Added quiz mode time tracking to UserStats.quizModeTimeSeconds in trackQuizCompletion, and use actual timeSpentSeconds for daily activity instead of hardcoded 60s

Fixed 3 bugs: 1) Share boxes now clickable in DailyRewardsStrip with onShareClaim callback; 2) Share request now sends client_date to server; 3) Day 7 check-in no longer double-counts coins (removed redundant claimDay7BonusIfEligible return)
